device: iPhone 18 Pro simulator (CrewCue-C), iOS 27.0, Debug build
action: Signed in as crew (dev session, local memory API, 50k course with aid stations) and opened crewcue://dev/schedule-sheet. Pace opens with the schedule; every stop shows its elapsed time and UTC clock.

checked.Success: API stops listed: e.g. 'START 00:00 08:29 UTC', 'AID 1 1:22:37 09:52 UTC'; each row caption shows '<UTC clock> · <elapsed>' (projected rows add the planned stop).
checked.Empty: Room with no course: 'No stops on this sheet.' under 'No aid stations yet'.
checked.Error: GET /schedule returned 500 for a room never loaded on this device: 'Couldn't load the schedule.'
checked.Offline: Loaded online, then the connection dropped and the app relaunched: 'Offline. Schedule not updated. The last sheet stays readable on this device.' with the cached rows still listed.
checked.Accessibility labels: AXUniqueId crewcue.schedule-sheet on the schedule group.
